title: Lubrication Pressure — Marginal
description: Lubrication delivery pressure P040 = {val} bar. Marginally above critical but {val2}% below nominal. Pump current P042 = {val3} A.
probable_cause: Partially blocked strainer, slightly worn pump, or increased line restriction.
diagnostic_steps: Check pump discharge pressure with calibrated gauge
remedy: Clean strainer. If pump discharge confirmed low, plan pump replacement at next maintenance.
required_action: Log fault. Schedule maintenance within 24 hours. Reduce feed rate by 20%.
